caption: The drawing depicts a single round plate shown from a top view, positioned centrally on the page. The outer rim of the plate is outlined with a thin yellow line. Decorative yellow scrollwork patterns are visible at the top and bottom edges of the rim, centered horizontally. The left and right sides of the plate feature blue line drawings depicting scenes with trees, buildings, and possibly a bridge or fence, rendered in a sketch-like manner. The plate is shaded in light blue and gray to suggest form, with the center left largely unadorned. Below the main image, there is a small technical drawing of the plate in pencil, which shows the plate's diameter and a cross-sectional profile with dimensions marked. The background of the drawing is a neutral, uncolored paper. The drawing includes notes and scale information written in pencil.
title: Platter
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
